title: Nutty Browned Portuguese Spaghetti Pasta
description: A buttery and glassy-jelly Portuguese dish featuring spaghetti, lardons-render, and paleo-friendly ingredients, perfect for a brunch mood. This recipe combines the richness of lardons with the simplicity of spaghetti.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and add the lardons, cooking until browned and crispy.
Add the olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large serving dish, combine the cooked spaghetti, browned lardons, and garlic mixture.
Top the spaghetti with chopped walnuts and paleo-friendly parmesan cheese.
Toss the spaghetti to combine all the ingredients.
Serve the Nutty Browned Portuguese Spaghetti Pasta hot and enjoy.
Garnish with additional chopped walnuts and parmesan cheese if desired.
